summary: Iteration 54: Meta → BankEzee Connect port full parity pass. Backend: 28/28 pytest passed on /app/backend/tests/test_iter54_meta_parity.py covering identity/role scoping, dashboard stats, sync, leads listing/filter, GP+processor scoping, forbidden bulk-assign/bulk-delete/user-management for non-admin, files/report/CSV export, call-logs, partners, processors workload, note+status write, and Connect regression (auth/me, files/dashboard/stats, leads, users). Frontend (Playwright, preview URL): (1) Admin admin@bankezee.com sees full navy sidebar with all 7 nav items (Dashboard, Leads, Files, File Reports, Call Logs, Growth Partners, User Management), all metric cards (Total Leads, Files, In Progress, Unassigned), Sync Now button, Leads with 25 rows + bulk-assign + bulk-delete buttons on selection, Lead detail with status buttons + notes; Growth Partners page shows 6 partner cards with Assigned/Converted counts; User Management contains NO 'Danger' or 'Reset' text; CSV export button present on File Reports. (2) Ops (rama@bankezee.com) sees sidebar WITHOUT Growth Partners and User Management nav; has assign dropdowns on 25 lead rows. (3) Processor (teja@bankezee.com) sees exactly 1 scoped lead in /meta/leads; FILE detail exposes meta-save-file-btn (can edit banks) and processing status controls; no partners/users nav. (4) Growth Partner (yarragondaanusha@gmail.com / MetaGP123!) logs in, sees 25 scoped leads on first page, NO assign dropdown, NO bulk action bar, NO select-all checkbox, NO partners/users nav. Access gate for user-without-meta_access could not be verified end-to-end (only test candidate manager2 credentials incorrect on this preview) but MetaProtectedRoute code path is present in App.js and admin-with-meta_access reaches /meta correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: MetaLayout.js unconditionally renders Dashboard/Files/FileReports/CallLogs nav for all meta roles including processor+GP. Processor and GP see 'Growth Partners'/'User Management' correctly hidden, but 'File Reports' and 'Call Logs' are visible to processor and GP - if spec intends those staff-only, add meta.isStaff gate. Current spec text says processor 'only sees leads where they are the assigned processor' - it does not forbid these tabs, so current behaviour is likely fine but worth confirming with product.
LeadDetail testid for processing status select is 'meta-processing-status-select' while problem statement mentions 'meta-set-status-*' family; both exist so no bug - just documentation drift.
GP visible leads on Leads page cap at 25 (page_size default) but Partners card for Anusha shows 26 assigned - pagination works (backend total confirms this in previous iterations).
seed_data_creation: TestLeadWrite added one 'TEST_iter54 auto note' + status=CALL_BACK to the first lead returned to admin (meta_leads only, isolated collection)
